research_scope: Five skills selected after live repository duplicate checks. Acquisition and classification are recorded only where supported by current references; unsupported technical fields remain unresolved.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked current Xenoverse 2 references against an independent searchable PQ reward transcription and a current skill guide.

records.name: Solar Flare
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 3 — World Tournament Tag Team
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference lists Solar Flare as an Other Super requiring 200 Ki and obtainable by the Time Patroller from PQ03. It blinds/stuns affected opponents. Exact reward-slot semantics are not asserted beyond the direct PQ listing.

records.name: Paralyze Beam
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 4 — Prepare for the Attack of Saiyans!
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference classifies Paralyze Beam as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super that fires a short-range beam backward and briefly stuns the target. The current reference lists PQ04 as its unlock source.

records.name: Meteor Strike
records.mechanics_notes: Independent current-game skill listings and the original PQ reward transcription identify Meteor Strike as a PQ06 Strike Super. The exact Ki cost and reward-slot semantics are left unresolved here.

records.name: Shine Shot
records.mechanics_notes: The original searchable PQ reward transcription and current PQ guide place Shine Shot in PQ07. Exact resource cost and reward-slot semantics are left unresolved.

records.name: Wall of Defense
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-list references classify Wall of Defense as an Other Super and the PQ reward transcription places it in PQ10. Exact resource cost and reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.
